title: Finite coefficient presentations and normalization of smooth operations
statement: Fix the finite-field datum, coefficient prime and closure of [def-pur-conventions], and a smooth separated morphism $f:X\to Y$ of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the strict rational stages and common-stage categories [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], the PBC stages [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], and the canonical identity-on-integral-coefficients equivalences $J_{W,E},J_W$ of [lem-pur-framework-pbc-coefficient-category-comparison]. Define $F^s_E$ to be either the actual $Lf_E^*(-)(d)[2d]$ or $Rf_E^!$, and $F^s$ its actual common-stage operation [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-coefficient-twists-detailed, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Define its PBC presentation by $F^p_E=J_{X,E}F^s_EJ_{Y,E}^{-1}$ and the finite comparison $r_E:J_{X,E}F^s_E\cong F^p_EJ_{Y,E}$ using the unit of $J_{Y,E}$.
